The '''Capture of the Death Star test unit''' was a mission undertaken by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the early stages of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Prelude==
At some point prior to the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a [[Unidentified test unit Death Star|test unit model]] of the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] was developed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as a means to test the concept of the battlestation.

==The mission==
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Force Collection}}
During the Galactic Civil War, the Rebel Alliance attacked the test unit, believing it to be the actual Death Star. After storming through the Stormtroopers assigned to guard it, they eventually reached the control room, only to discover that it was only a test unit.
{{Endgame}}

==Aftermath==
After the Rebel victory, the Imperial troops evacuated. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] later ordered for the station to self-destruct.

==Behind the scenes==
This mission first appeared in the Android/iPhone card game ''[[Star Wars: Force Collection]]'' for the optional quest "Battle of the Death Star", which ran until September 25, [[2013]]. The campaign ended with a Light Side victory.
